shortDescription: PostgreSQL Connection Pool Saturation on Production Cluster (#1)
description: Problem Investigation #1: Investigating systemic underlying root cause for repeated incident alerts on db-postgres-primary.
rootCause: Unindexed database query performing full table scan during nightly backup batch.
workaround: Restart connection pool proxy service and scale max connections from 200 to 500.

shortDescription: Active Directory Kerberos Ticket Expiration Sync Failure (#2)
description: Problem Investigation #2: Investigating systemic underlying root cause for repeated incident alerts on k8s-prod-cluster-east-1.
rootCause: Clock skew drift between Active Directory DC 01 and NTP server exceeds 300 seconds.
workaround: Purge expired KBT cache on primary domain controller host dc-east-01.

shortDescription: Kubernetes Ingress NGINX Memory Leak under High Traffic Load (#3)
description: Problem Investigation #3: Investigating systemic underlying root cause for repeated incident alerts on ad-dc-master-01.
rootCause: Memory buffer leak in NGINX v1.21 ingress worker process during HTTP/2 multiplexing.
workaround: Trigger pod rolling restart and increase pod memory limits from 2Gi to 8Gi.

shortDescription: Okta Webhook Session Token Timeout on SSO Portal (#4)
description: Problem Investigation #4: Investigating systemic underlying root cause for repeated incident alerts on okta-auth-gw-01.
rootCause: OAuth callback handler missing retry backoff header handling under rate-limiting.
workaround: Force OAuth 2.0 token re-issuance and clear Redis session key cache.

shortDescription: SAP Financials ERP Database Deadlock during End-of-Month Run (#5)
description: Problem Investigation #5: Investigating systemic underlying root cause for repeated incident alerts on router-border-nyc-01.
rootCause: BGP route flapping caused by faulty fiber SFP transceiver on interface eth0.
workaround: Execute `sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse=1` and flush BGP neighbor tables.
